reading_comprehension.q: 1. According to Matthew 5:3-10, who receives the kingdom of heaven?
2. Why does Jesus call His followers 'the salt of the earth' and 'the light of the world'?
reading_comprehension.a: Because, like salt and light, Christians should make a real difference in the world: salt preserves and gives flavor, light shows the way and cannot be hidden.

reading_comprehension.q: 3. What does Jesus teach about prayer in Matthew 6:9-13?
reading_comprehension.a: He teaches His disciples to pray to 'Our Father in heaven', to honor God's name, to ask for His kingdom and will, for daily bread, for forgiveness, and for deliverance from temptation and evil.

reading_comprehension.q: 4. According to Matthew 6:19-21, where should we store our treasures, and why?
reading_comprehension.a: In heaven, because earthly treasures are destroyed by moth and rust and stolen by thieves, but heavenly treasures last forever; and where our treasure is, there our heart will be also.

exercises.title: Exercise 1: Word Stress — Mark the Stressed Syllable
exercises.instruction: Underline the stressed syllable in each word. Remember: in longer words, only ONE syllable carries the main stress. Say each word aloud after you mark it.

exercises.title: Exercise 2: Present Perfect — since or for
exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with since or for. Remember: since + a point in time (2019, Monday, I was a child); for + a length of time (three years, two weeks, a long time).

exercises.title: Exercise 3: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form. Present perfect = a finished time is NOT given, the result matters now. Past simple = a finished time IS given (yesterday, in 2019, last week).

exercises.title: Exercise 4: Vocabulary Matching
exercises.instruction: Match each word with its correct definition.

exercises.title: Exercise 5: Listening Comprehension
exercises.instruction: Listen to the audio (b1-lesson-01-listening.mp3) twice. Then answer the questions.

exercises.title: Exercise 6: Ministry Translation Lab (Vietnamese to English)
exercises.instruction: Translate into natural English. Use the present perfect and this lesson's vocabulary.

written: Write 5 sentences about your own life using the present perfect: 2 with since, 2 with for, 1 with already or yet. Example: I have believed in Jesus since 2018.
Write 3 sentences using 3 different vocabulary words from Section 3 (blessed, meek, merciful, treasure, forgive, light).
Write the Beatitudes (Matthew 5:3-6) in English from memory, then check your work against the Bible.
homework.listening: Listen to the audio again. Write down, in English, the three promises Jesus gives in the Beatitudes section. Then answer: What does the narrator say 'blessed' means?
